An '''reek''' fought and was [[Death|killed]] at [[Petranaki Arena]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Episode II" />

==Biography==
[[File:Bottleneck-TroubleonGeonosis.png|thumb|left|300px|The reek closes in alongside the acklay and nexu]]
After [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] were captured by [[Count]] [[Dooku]], the [[Sith Lord]] had them be executed at the [[Petranaki Arena]] on the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]]. This reek, along with an [[Unidentified acklay (Petranaki Arena)|acklay]] and an [[Unidentified nexu|nexu]], were chosen to kill the three. However, Skywalker managed to escape from his chains and [[Taming beasts|tamed]] the beast.

After the [[Jedi Order]] presented themselves at the scene, a fight began to break out in the arena. During this time, the reek found [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] and charged at him. Fett was trampled by the reek and had his [[jetpack]] destroyed. When the reek came around at him again, Fett shot the reek and killed it. The bounty hunter would later be killed at the hands of [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]], and the Jedi Order would flee the arena moments later.<ref name="Episode II" />
